title: Benefit Overpayment Accounts — Reinstatement Months After Returned Installments
content:
When a defaulted repayment plan on Benefit Overpayment Accounts is reinstated, the reinstatement months over which the balance is spread follow the installments returned unpaid under the plan.

## Returns that count

The return entries counted are those booked within the whole months elapsed from the plan's first installment due date to the handling date plus the month in progress; an entry falls within when the whole months from its booking date to the handling date are fewer than that number.

## Months allowed

| Installments returned unpaid under the plan | Reinstatement months |
|---|---|
| Two or more | The multiple-return share, 0.5 (50 percent), of the classification's maximum plan months |
| Exactly one | The single-return share, 0.75 (75 percent), of the classification's maximum plan months |
| None | The classification's maximum plan months in full |

Each share is counted in whole months, with any fraction of a month dropped.

## Schedule by classification

| Classification | Maximum plan months | Two or more returns | One return | No return |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error | 60 | 30 | 45 | 60 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Employer Reporting Error | 60 | 30 | 45 | 60 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Appeal Reversal | 60 | 30 | 45 | 60 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error | 48 | 24 | 36 | 48 |
| Fraud Overpayment — First Offense | 36 | 18 | 27 | 36 |
| Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense | 24 | 12 | 18 | 24 |

*Hypothetical:* a plan with a first installment due date of 15 March, reinstated on 2 October (6 whole months elapsed, so returns within 7 months count). Return entries were booked on 20 May and 18 August; both count, and a Fraud Overpayment — First Offense plan is allowed 18 reinstatement months.
